q: Sfakiani pita, a cheese pie of local fame, something between a crepe and a pancake. The cheese is xynomyzithra, panfried and served with a drizzling of thyme honey.
2005, Liz Smith, Dishing: Great Dish--and Dishes--from America's Most Beloved Gossip Columnist:

In the southwestern Sfakia area, the thin Sfakiani pita, filled with myzithra and topped with honey, is a dessert; however, travel just a bit further west, to Paleohora, and you will find your myzithropitakia will probably be made of the sour xynomyzithra, according to local custom.
This crisp, lemony white is made using xynisteri grapes, imported centuries before from the Greek mainland.
